# partiteai_system_metric (Data Source)

One evaluation metric that came with the product, looked up by `key`. Requires an enterprise deployment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Stable identifier of the metric, which is what a rubric refers to it by.

### Read-Only

- `complexity` (String) Model complexity the metric judges at, when it judges.
- `description` (String) What the metric measures.
- `examples` (Attributes List) Worked examples shown to the judging model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--examples))
- `input_fields` (Attributes List) Values a rubric supplies when it uses this metric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_fields))
- `name` (String) Name shown to a person.
- `prompt` (String) Prompt the judging model is given.
- `type` (String) `JUDGED` for a metric a model scores, `COMPUTED` for one worked out from the trace.

<a id="nestedatt--examples"></a>
### Nested Schema for `examples`

Read-Only:

- `judgment` (String)
- `rating` (Number)
- `scenario` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--input_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `input_fields`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `required` (Boolean)
- `type` (String)
